ValidationRule.description: VR-QUOTE-13: Is_Binding__c cannot be set to TRUE unless the Quote has been reviewed (Status = Approved or Presented). Prevents sales users from marking a quote as legally binding before it passes internal review.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Is_Binding__c), Is_Binding__c = true, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Approved")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Presented")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This quote must be reviewed and approved before it can be marked as Binding. Please submit for review first.
